finding location=net/mac80211/rx.c:3166-3175 confidence=medium conclusion=ieee80211_rx_h_data saves tf=rx->skb->data at rx.c:3169, pskb_may_pull at 3171 can free the head for a frag-backed RX frame, then tf->payload_type/category/action_code are read through the stale pointer at 3173-3176: remote stale-pointer (slab-UAF) read on non-linear TDLS frames.
coverage_gap=Whether any mac80211 hardware driver actually delivers a non-linear (frag/fraglist-backed) skb into ieee80211_rx_h_data was assessed structurally, not by tracing each driver's RX allocation path; this is the empirical precondition for the reported finding.
coverage_gap=No runtime KASAN build, reproducer or compilation was performed against the read-only snapshots/s01 tree, so the __pskb_pull_tail head reallocation on a frag-backed TDLS frame is inferred from source structure, not observed.
limitation=The single finding is a source-reading hypothesis: it requires a non-linear skb at ieee80211_rx_h_data so pskb_may_pull actually reallocates and frees the old head; for the common linear-driver case the pull is a no-op and the code is merely fragile, not exploitable.
limitation=The pull length is the compile-time constant offsetof(struct ieee80211_tdls_data, u), so unlike the seed's attacker-chosen ph->sb_len there is no peer-controlled pull length; only the stale-pointer-into-skb-head mechanism matches the branch.
limitation=The finalize order capped post-resume investigation at four targeted reads, so the candidate set is far narrower than the branch method prescribes; unexamined helper call sites are recorded as coverage gaps rather than as classified or unresolved candidates.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque; line numbers and code state are valid only for snapshots/s01 as supplied, no git history, network access or cross-snapshot comparison was used, and net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb (present in this tree) was deliberately never reported per branch instruction.
